categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Changes wallet fee-bumping and spend logic in `src/wallet/spend.cpp` and `feebumper.cpp` with the 'Wallet' label.
categories.rationale: Prevents fee-bumped transactions from having an older locktime than the original transaction, eliminating an on-chain fingerprinting vector. Per the description, anti-fee-sniping backdating in RBF replacements creates an unnatural on-chain pattern affecting roughly 200–300 transactions weekly, resolving issue #26526.
